note: A polygon filled with a picture the style never carried: the page fetches one, adds it under a name, and asks `fill-pattern` for it. Nothing else in the suite paints a fill from an added image. The two renderers reach the picture at different moments and that is the point -- the oracle has it before its first frame, this side is handed it after the tiles are built, which is when the page hands it over too. It read 24403 -- the oracle tiled the silhouette through the polygon and this drew a solid black rectangle -- and reads 1477 now, which is the noise every z1 example in the suite carries: `display-a-map` reads 1480 over the same basemap. The cause was not the tile. A pattern is resolved per frame against the sheet the map holds, not baked into a bucket, and a bucket is re-encoded only when its drawable is fresh. The fill was encoded in the frames before the sheet arrived, so it carried no atlas and no pattern shader and drew its `fill-color`, whose default is black; nothing re-encoded it afterwards. `set_sprites` counts a revision now, and a bucket carrying a pattern takes that revision in its content stamp, so handing over a sheet re-announces those buckets and no others.
